Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet King Street Industrial Three-Drawer TV Media Console, Walnut, Black Metal, Glass
Colors: Oak
Materials: Metal
A wooden console appears to float within a metal frame on this modern entertainment center. A tempered glass top will hold a wide-screen TV while your other AV equipment can be stored on the shelf below. 59.1"L x 15.7"W x 15.7"H Engineered wood, walnut veneer drawers, metal legs and tempered glass top Modern Industrial Three drawers provide storage space No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
